column1: # Do outdoor creatures act on a party that is walking?
# `encounters.md §2.1` runs the encounter probe every overworld turn, and
# `active-objects.md §8` has the walker's queued adjacency reactions completed
# by the same per-turn block. Neither ran on an accepted step before
# u5-engine#17, so the overworld was inert while the party moved: no wandering
# encounter spawned, and no creature ever initiated anything.
# The two sides do not share a random stream, so this scenario compares
# *behaviour*, not content: over sixty night steps each side should show
# encounter activity - a creature appearing in the viewport, an attack line, a
# conflict - rather than an empty world. Read the viewports as much as the
# requires-seed: the party on the Britannia overworld at 02:00, when the encounter threshold can fire
